title: In This Town, the Clock Stops at Midnight

lines.t: In this town, the big clock stops every night at midnight. And every kid knows three rules.
Rule number one: never be outside when the clock stops.
Rule number two: never look at the clock face.
And rule number three: if you hear it ticking backwards... hide.
Because every kid who broke these rules got frozen. Forever.
My name is Leo. And last night, I broke all three.
It started at exactly midnight. The ticking outside my window just... stopped.
Then my phone buzzed. It was my best friend, Max.
Leo, I'm outside. Everything stopped. I can't...
And the call cut off.
I grabbed my flashlight and ran outside. The whole street was frozen.
A dog, stuck in the middle of a jump. Leaves, floating in the air.
And Max. Frozen on his skateboard, halfway across the road.
Then I heard it. Tick... tock... backwards.
It was coming from the clock tower. And there was a light on, all the way at the top.
I broke rule number two. I looked right at the clock face.
Its hands were spinning the wrong way.
I ran up the tower stairs. Two hundred steps.
At the top, there were giant gears, glowing purple. And someone was turning a huge golden key.
It was the Mayor.
Every night I stop the clock. This town never gets older... and I stay Mayor forever.
He turned the key again. Down below, the whole town sank deeper into the freeze.
But I noticed something. Every time the gears turned, a tiny candle in the middle of the clock flickered.
The candle was powering everything.
So I did the only thing I could think of. I blew it out.
The gears screeched. The key snapped. And the clock struck... thirteen.
Down below, the dog finished its jump. The leaves fell. Max rolled right into a trash can.
And the Mayor? Every year he had stolen came back at once. His hair went white in three seconds.
The next morning, the town had a new Mayor. And the clock never stopped again.
At least, I thought so. Until tonight, when my alarm clock started ticking... backwards.
